designationHistory.name: Hiddenwood Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the refuge as the Hiddenwood Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 8150, reserving lands in McLean County, North Dakota, as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds.
designationHistory.note: Renamed Hiddenwood National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940.
